candidates.original_title: Validation of the interprofessional collaborative competency attainment survey (ICCAS)
candidates.description: Validation of the ICCAS instrument for assessing interprofessional collaborative competency attainment, demonstrating its internal factor structure and pre-post effect sizes.
candidates.citation_sentence: In their psychometric study of the ICCAS instrument, the authors obtained data from 584 participants from 15 different IPECP programmes in Canada and New Zealand (Archibald, Trumpower, & MacDonald, 2014).
candidates.notes: The replication made two deliberate methodological changes from the original: (1) changed the rating scale from 7-point Likert to 5-point qualitative, and (2) added a transition item. These changes keep the same general paradigm but prevent classification as 'direct.' The authors explicitly state they followed the Ottawa methodology, and the results are framed as confirming/validating the original instrument.
